//: Copy to <server-root>/Config/serverConfig.json on the VPS. The kit reads it from ./Config/serverConfig.json relative to the process working directory, so systemd must set WorkingDirectory to the server root. Every value here can also be passed as a -flag on the command line; the flag wins over the file.
//central: Address+port that CLIENTS connect to for login and character select. publicAddress must be the VPS public IP (or a DNS name that resolves to it) - it is handed out to clients verbatim, so 127.0.0.1 here means nobody outside the box can play.
//cluster: Internal bus between central, map-spawn and map servers. Loopback only on a single-box deploy - never open this port to the internet.
//channels: One channel is plenty until you outgrow a single box.
//mapspawn: spawnExePath empty = the map-spawn process re-launches its own binary for each map. spawnMaps holds MapInfo asset ids (asset file name unless Id is overridden). spawnStartPort is the first map-server port; each additional map takes the next port up, so open a small range in the firewall.
//map: mapPort/mapMaxConnections apply when a map server is started manually rather than by the spawner.
//database: The database manager is the only process that talks to MySQL. It has NO authentication on this port - keep it bound to the box and blocked at the firewall. databaseOptionIndex indexes MMOServerInstance -> DatabaseNetworkManager.databaseOptions, which in this project is [0] = SQLite, [1] = MySQL. The VPS needs 1: only Windows sqlite3.dll ships with the kit, so SQLite is not an option on Linux.
//websocket: Only needed for WebGL clients. Leave false for desktop builds - the default LiteNetLib transport is UDP.
